name: Trimming sails (passive, while sailing)
note: Supplementary XP on every trip: trim when a gust appears (every ~30 s). XP per trim depends on mast & sails tier (Sailing/Construction to build): wooden+linen 1/1 = 10.5; oak+linen 24/11 = 19.5; teak+canvas 36/26 = 30; mahogany+canvas 52/45 = 48; camphor+canvas 68/60 = 64; ironwood+cotton 83/77 = 80; rosewood+cotton 94/85 = 125. Upgrades are built from logs + matching nails + bolts of linen/canvas/cotton (raft: 5 logs, 20 nails, 5 bolts; skiff: 10/40/5; sloop: 15/60/10) — cards: Logs/Oak logs/…, Bronze nails/Iron nails/…, Bolt of linen/Bolt of canvas/Bolt of cotton, plus Hammer+Saw. Wind catcher (53 Sailing/47 Con, needs Captured wind mote from Jubbly Jive Shark rank): trim XP -25% but each released mote gives 40 XP; gale catcher (79/70) 70 XP per mote. The starting raft comes with the wooden mast.
wiki: Sailing training: "The initial raft that players receive after completing Pandemonium will grant 10.5 experience for every trim; players can gain more experience from trimming on higher-level sails and boats."

name: Blast Furnace: stoke the stove

name: Dwarf multicannon

name: Tonalztics of ralos
note: Thrown weapon with unlimited ammo; reward from the Fortis Colosseum.
wiki: "a one-handed thrown weapon that requires level 75 Ranged to equip, obtained by participating in the Fortis Colosseum ... effectively provides unlimited \"ammo\""

requirements.label: Crossbow
requirements.note: Any crossbow (not love crossbow/ballistae)

name: Gnome Ball
note: Ranged xp per throw; 4-7 Ranged and Agility per goal, +25 each for winning.
wiki: "Ranged experience is gained each time the ball is thrown, while both Ranged and Agility experience are rewarded when a goal is scored."

name: Mage Training Arena: Telekinetic Theatre (maze bonus)

name: Mage Training Arena: Creature Graveyard (fruit deposit)

requirements.label: Runes for Bones to Bananas / Peaches

note: 5 Magic xp per banana deposited, 10 per peach (Bones to Peaches needs 60 Magic and the MTA unlock), plus cast xp.
wiki: "Each banana deposited will reward 5 Magic experience, whilst each peach will reward 10 Magic experience."

name: Mage Training Arena: Alchemists' Playground (coin deposit)

wiki: "For every coin deposited in the minigame, players will receive 2 Magic experience."

name: Arceuus Library book delivery

name: Hallowed Sepulchre coffins

name: Grand Hallowed Coffin (Sepulchre floor 5)
note: End of floor 5 (92 Agility). Needs 84 Thieving, or 66 Thieving with 92 Agility.
wiki: "It requires either Thieving 84, or Thieving 66 with Agility 92, to open and grants 200 experience when successfully looted."

name: Pickpocket Desert Phoenix
note: North-west of the Ruins of Uzer; always gives a phoenix feather.
wiki: Thieving info: Desert Phoenix | level 25 | xp 26 | Pickpocket; drop Phoenix feather (Always)

name: Chompy bird hunting

requirements.label: Comp ogre bow
requirements.note: Or the ogre bow (no card)

wiki: "They can only be killed after completing the Big Chompy Bird Hunting quest ... Each kill yields a chompy bird corpse which can be plucked for feathers, a raw chompy, bones and grants 30 Hunter experience"

name: Sandworm castings (Port Piscarilius)
note: Dig castings on the north-east beach; 10 xp when you get a bucket of sandworms (chance scales with Hunter level). Level is unboostable.
wiki: "When players have a spade and a bucket in their inventory, they can dig the castings with level 15 Hunter (not boostable) ... Obtaining sandworms will provide 10 Hunter experience."

name: Moss lizard (Neypotzli)
note: xp = 90% of Hunter level, max 90 (18 shown at level 20). Earthbound Cavern in Neypotzli; access is gained during Perilous Moons (partial). Raw moss lizards are Moons of Peril food.
wiki: Hunter info: Moss Lizard | level 20 | xp "90% of Hunter level up to 90xp" | trap Rope

name: Trouble Brewing: sweetgrubs
note: Trouble Brewing minigame (needs Cabin Fever and 40 Cooking); 40 Hunter xp per sweetgrub drawn from a mound. Team NPCs have no cards.
wiki: "Raw rat meat can be used on the mounds to collect sweetgrubs, with 40 Hunter experience being awarded for each sweetgrub successfully collected."

name: Trouble Brewing: bitternuts
note: Dye a minigame monkey in your team colour and send it up a bitternut tree; 50 Hunter xp per bitternut.
wiki: "When obtained players are granted 50 Hunter experience."

name: Bonecrusher (passive, bones from kills)
